mapper.select: select id, coalesce(handle, id) as handle, nickname, avatar_url, profile_banner_url, bio, location, source, profile_visibility, show_liked_on_profile, show_favorites_on_profile, created_at, updated_at from users where id = #{userId}
select coalesce(sum(s.like_count), 0) from content_items c join content_stats s on s.content_id = c.id where c.author_user_id = #{userId} and c.status = 'published'

select coalesce(sum(s.like_count), 0) from content_items c join content_stats s on s.content_id = c.id where c.author_user_id = #{userId} and c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' and c.show_on_profile = true
